# Tomato plan 2026

## Varieties

- San Marzano for sauce; long, meaty, few seeds.
- Cherokee Purple for slicing; dark, smoky flavour.
- Sungold cherry tomatoes for snacking.

## Watering

Water deeply at the base every morning in summer, never on the leaves. Uneven
watering causes blossom end rot and split fruit. Mulch with straw to keep the
soil moist and to stop soil splashing onto the lower leaves.

## Disease

Early blight shows as brown rings on the lowest leaves. Remove affected leaves,
keep good airflow and rotate beds every year. See [[compost]] for what to do
with diseased plants (not the compost pile).

## Support

Use tall cages for indeterminate varieties and prune suckers once a week.
